correctness.rationale: Structural induction removes nested contingency because modal outputs are cluster-constant; truth vectors depend on a local affine evaluation and the indicators s outside the annihilator of the valuation-difference span. Singleton tests and full/hyperplane spans prove exact linear independence of D=k+2^k generators for every k>=1. For <=k worlds the sole dependency is parity of all nonzero contingencies, by the J+I rank argument, and a (k+1)-world affine basis breaks it. Standard finite-dimensional linear rank gives a D lower bound on any teaching set; an explicit D-test family achieves it. The checker independently computes ranks for k=1..4 and randomized nested-formula normalizations for k<=3, corroborating but not replacing proof.

value.rationale: A complete expressive classification of a motivated affine/non-simple modal fragment, with exact equivalence-class count and independent sharply optimal teaching dimension plus a sharp finite S5 world cutoff. Unlike generic local tabularity or numerical enumeration, the rank defect explains why k-world frames miss a unique expressive feature and why k+1 worlds recover all distinctions. These are direct invariants in finite-variable modal expressivity and teaching theory.
